title: Junta approximation inner product identity
statement: Let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$ be a Boolean function and let $J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$. The uniform inner product of $f$ with its sign-thresholded coordinate projection onto $J$ equals the uniform inner product of that coordinate projection with the same thresholded function.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a set of coordinates in $\{1,\ldots,n\}$
